**Shipped install-home-scaffold: HOME.md scaffold + agnostic index helper**

**What**: Delivered `install-home-scaffold` to main (#184, archived). Part 1: `brain:env:init` now scaffolds `brain/HOME.md` create-if-absent via new `brain/core/templates/HOME.template.md` (managed → distributed) + `brain/scripts/lib/home-scaffold.mjs` `ensureHome(root)` (mirrors ensureBrainConfig, never overwrites), wired into bootstrap.sh. Part 2: extracted HOME.md ADR-index mechanics into agnostic `brain/scripts/lib/home-index.mjs` `insertAdrLink()` (pure, 5 branches, CRLF-preserving, exit codes 0/1/2/3) + rewired the Claude adapter `.claude/commands/project-bootstrap-adrs.md` Phase 4 to CALL it. `check-brain-nav.mjs` excludes `brain/core/templates/`.
**Why**: Consumers never got a brain/HOME.md (it's in neither managed nor local arrays). The auto-ADR scan (ADR-0013 project-bootstrap-adrs skill) ALREADY EXISTED and generates ADRs; the only gaps were (a) no HOME.md created at install and (b) the index-patch logic was Claude-coupled prose that aborted on an empty section (violating ADR-0013 "never orphan an accepted ADR"). User insisted on agent-agnosticism (brain = Claude today, Codex tomorrow, cf #123), so Part 2 became "agnostic helper + rewire" not "fix the Claude prose".
**Where**: brain/core/templates/HOME.template.md, brain/scripts/lib/home-scaffold.mjs, brain/scripts/lib/home-index.mjs, brain/scripts/lib/home-helpers-neutrality.test.mjs, brain/scripts/check-brain-nav.mjs, brain/scripts/bootstrap.sh, .claude/commands/project-bootstrap-adrs.md. Delivery: PR #185→#186→#187 (chain) + #188 (REQ-7 neutrality) + #190 (archive). 822 tests.
**Learned**: REQ-7 agnosticism is now ENFORCED by a neutrality source-scan test (mirrors run-check/substrate from #164) — helpers may not name Claude/Codex/etc. HOME.template.md must reach 100% of a fresh consumer's brain/core/**/*.md via BFS (check-brain-nav) with zero project/** links. Deferred follow-ups: rename-dup, CLI arg-shape validation, blank-line nit; accepted non-goal: HOME.md drift re-sync on upgrade.
